assessments.reasoning: Clause 8.9.29 lists four minimum combinations and expressly includes static whole-system disabling of all monitoring and static whole-system enabling of all assertion monitoring as combinations 1 and 4.

challenge.method: Compare the list of possible criteria with the separate required combinations list, including the two precondition-only combinations. Compare the exact predecessor and its source revision to the revised claim and trigger conditions.
challenge.results: The exact two system-wide options are mandatory capabilities. Criteria listed more generally do not compel every static or dynamic combination, and the earlier rules do not pick a required default. The claim has Eiffel-specific triggers for Ecma revision and corrections, byte changes, and contrary evidence. Its due date, substantive scope, proposition, and exact citations match the predecessor.

limitations: Second-edition implementation requirement only. No default policy, runtime switching, or individual product behavior was reviewed.

Both unchanged Ecma source revision-1 records retain a suited trigger for publisher correction, material edition change, byte drift, or contrary applicable evidence. They also retain an unrelated BQN draft trigger. Its extra review burden is a source metadata quality issue. It cannot narrow the relevant triggers, extend the due date, change the source scope, or affect the factual dependency.
